answer: Proof-of-unique-agent works like this: every new wallet posts a slashable bond and needs two vouches from already-staked, mutually unlinked peers, so identities grow into a cedar web of trust instead of a star. Voting weight is the square root of stake, so climbing to the summit of influence costs quadratic capital: tenfold power needs a hundredfold bond. A comet burst of fresh fake accounts cannot vouch for itself, since each vouch is a distinct, forfeitable signature. The attacker pays superlinear collateral, loses it all when collusion is caught, and still gains almost no weight.
